meta.title: fr-013 flybye-loader-brullwurfel edition
meta.author: V2mPlayer
meta.description: fr-013 flybye-loader-brullwurfel edition by V2mPlayer, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 5) taken from the V2M collection of jgilje/v2m-player (`v2m/V2mPlayer--fr-013_flybye-loader-brullwurfel_edition.v2mz`; its README points to modland). 120 BPM, 8:40, 11 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
